answer.boundary: This is a Station Zero product invariant. It supports a broader proposal/commit inequality but does not prove every Agent/game UI requires the same Preview object or explicit button.
answer.counterfactualBreakage: Direct plan-to-effect would let model generation or browser refresh commit consequences without player authority, make re-planning ambiguous, and allow response loss to create duplicate/replacement turns. Ephemeral Preview would break audit/restart fidelity and 'what exactly did I commit?' review.
answer.decisiveFalsifier: P3 tests explicitly verify Preview non-authority before Commit. Changing the mutable Order invalidates/clears the Preview without touching World or P2 plan slots. The selected Preview survives restart before Commit; partial plan submission/P2 preparation resumes the same Preview/Batch; response-lost World results are observed under the original Turn Batch before a new Planning Head.
answer.epistemicBoundary: Tool metadata: frozen navigation is not automatically current owner truth and grants no evidence-sufficiency, research-reopen, mechanism-admission, or action authority. truthRole=non-authoritative-frozen-theory-navigation; currentness=not-revalidated-after-ofr3-freeze; actionAuthority=false; evidenceSufficiencyAuthority=false; mechanismAdmissionAuthority=false; researchReopenAuthority=false.
answer.invariant: Commander Order, sealed Plan Preview, explicit Commit and deterministic World consequence are distinct states. Preview is retained/recoverable and inspectable but has no World authority until explicit Commit binds the selected Preview to canonical faction plans/Turn Batch.
answer.reopenCondition: Reopen if a different Game mode deliberately grants autonomous plan authority, or a smaller product state preserves player agency, restart/recovery and exact committed-plan review.
answer.retainedConsequence: Persist Order/Preview identity/digests, expose player review, require explicit Commit, reuse selected Preview across restart/partial submission, and separate World effect receipts from planning state.
answer.strongestRival: Collapse planning and commitment: let model/policy plan generation directly occupy faction plan slots or mutate World, or treat Preview as ephemeral UI decoration with no authoritative identity.
answer.whyAttractive: Fewer states and less persistence: generate plans, execute them, and render whatever was generated as a preview.
